narrative_prose: Ryn stands in the humid galley of The Hearth, adjusting the pressure on the steam-jacketed kettles to counteract the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea as flickering copper light dances on the walls. The air smells intensely of roasted tubers and tastes faintly of metallic tang, while she listens to the bubbling stew and feels the intense heat radiating from the stovetop. Realizing the thermal mass needs to be monitored closely to prevent the feast from freezing, she presses the glowing command baton firmly into Silas's hands.
